en.name: High Priest
en.ability: Each day, publicly choose a unique living player to bless: if a majority of players agree, something good happens to them.

revisions.v1: Each day, publicly choose a unique living player to bless: if a majority of players agree, something good happens to them.

en.flavor: "To ignore the signs of the gods is itself to deny their very existence." - Marcus Tullius Cicero 106 B.C. – 43 B.C.
en.otherNightReminder: If the High Priest successfully blessed a player today, something good happens to that player and/or their team.

zh.name: 大祭司
zh.ability: 每个白天，你可以公开选择一名之前未选择过的存活玩家去祝福：如果多数玩家同意，他的身上会发生一些好的事情。

revisions.v1: 每个白天，你可以公开选择一名之前未选择过的存活玩家去祝福：如果多数玩家同意，他的身上会发生一些好的事情。

zh.flavor: ‘无视神发出的信号本身就是在否认他们的真实存在。’-马尔库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗 前106-前43
zh.otherNightReminder: 如果今天白天一名玩家被祝福，他的身上会发生一些好的事情。
